_comment: show/say map for make_narration.py --say-map. `show` is the sentence as written (captions, proof). `say` is what the voice reads. Applied in order: literal replace, regex replace, then every character in `drop` is removed. Put product names respelled by syllable, acronyms spelled out, numbers and clock times as words. Only the spoken form changes: captions keep the real spelling. Whisper cannot confirm a pronunciation, so play the line to the owner.
